profiles.name: catalog
profiles.definition: Native72 catalog capability/0.12: original UMF0.7/0.8 validation and selected native storage policy through one preparation implementation; compatible current acceptance, unchanged detection and exact stored historical reports; caller-owned transactions and person-scoped module/source reads. Normal input0.2 and report0.6 reference a single exact schema archive. Validator diagnostics reside once with the archive and are available through authorized accepted-document reads. Receipts retain registration identity, selected capabilities, provenance and rebind/key-backfill counts, without source, declaration, assertion or per-definition inventory copies. Changes to existing catalog rows retain exact before/after history; newly inserted definitions use their original archive and normalized rows. Native definition pins and recipes remain unchanged. Complete view profile0.4/wire0.2 carries source hashes, provenance and ordered dependency pins, with one shared source per archive and exact compatibility fragments derived on request; prior wire schemas remain historical. Unnamed record/field identities remain valid; unnamed fields bind to exact stable IDs and binding collisions refuse. Supported storage includes native exact scalar domains and facets, acyclic nested arrays/maps with complete descendant dependencies, declared relationships including owned lifecycle, compatible scalar/field presentation evolution, supported required/optional retained-value rebinding, and new alternate keys over supported existing or newly rebound required singular fields. Key backfill validates locked candidates, reports complete qualified duplicate counts and preserves versions when no object value changes; rebinding changes each affected object once and retains complete history, including owned roots and current reader dependencies. Existing key meaning, record-valued properties, descendant item evolution, unknown storage homes and unsupported semantic changes refuse. Unknown extension/action content remains verbatim in the original schema and does not become asserted value enforcement. No administrative installation or module grants are conferred. No external JavaScript executable is required; the compatibility bun_executable argument is ignored.
profiles.policyDefinition: Native catalog policy/0.2: ordinary authenticated person; registrar membership for acceptance, original reports and complete catalog view; current module reader or writer for person-scoped catalog and accepted document reads; exact installed release; READ COMMITTED; no installation administration authority. Rebinding requires affected module writer and complete original property/item read authority. Any report containing rebind data requires current original owner/property/item readers on acceptance, replay, unchanged and report reads, including after objects are deleted.

profiles.name: direct_read
profiles.definition: Native direct read capability/0.7: rootless and owned exact logical object identity/key/live pages; independent and owned directed edge identity/relationship pages; authority receipt visibility; committed native import provenance after deletion; current document-qualified module authority; read-only READ COMMITTED supported; original aggregate-root identities; no general historical records or compiler execution. Optional registered feed-consumer reached comparison returns true/false only for valid authorized issued receipts against committed protected checkpoints, with separate comparison profile. One-call live 1–3 qualified independent or owned directed relationship hops return unique numeric-ordered terminal scalar objects with path-local cycle exclusion, or limited/not-established with no records and restart. Logical attempted-state/result/byte limits and ordinary deadlines; no exact backend allocation guarantee or staged snapshot resume. Complete object values additionally admit one-level arrays/maps of required exact scalar items using original revision-qualified item definitions and current item-module read authority; sequences ordered and maps exact-key unique; record-valued property cells remain unsupported. Native64 adds bounded acyclic nested array/map properties and retained cells, complete original descendant definition/read dependencies and exact scalar leaves; prior profile definitions remain retained. Record-valued property cells and descendant item evolution remain unsupported. Native69 returns the original frozen aggregate-root identity through LogicalObject/0.1 while ScalarObject/0.4 remains rootless; key/object/relationship pages retain root-owner authority including lookahead; traversal checks every bounded reached node before rendering unique terminals.
profiles.policyDefinition: Native direct-read policy/0.3: ordinary authenticated person; current document-qualified reader or writer for object, property, relationship and endpoint dependencies used by each supported read; no writer-only gate; READ COMMITTED and supported read-only transactions; exact installed release; no raw table privileges. Current required item-definition module readers are included in pre-observation and final dependency checks; key/page scope refuses before observing protected routes when complete object interpretation is unauthorized. Owned reads additionally require each captured aggregate-root owner before disclosure and on final return, including buffered page lookahead and all bounded traversal nodes.

profiles.name: history
profiles.definition: Native retained history capability/0.3: committed entity mutation groups in xid/seq journal order below fixed snapshot xmin; exact wrapper/origin/physical correspondence and complete ordered group digest; original image revisions and definition pins; direct retained create/metadata version image or deleted version with its unmodified previous record; no current canonical row dependence; rootless and owned exact objects and independent or owned edges; no archive, cleanup, general reducer, source-fact retrieval or broad reconstruction evidence claims. Native64 adds bounded acyclic nested array/map properties and retained cells, complete original descendant definition/read dependencies and exact scalar leaves; prior profile definitions remain retained. Record-valued property cells and descendant item evolution remain unsupported. Native69 retains original before/after aggregate-root contexts for each affected object and edge, including descendant reparent versions and cascade deletion, without substituting live roots after deletion.
profiles.policyDefinition: Native retained history policy/0.2: ordinary authenticated current module reader or writer; every historical property declaration owner and old/new edge endpoint owner required; original accepted revision/pin interpretation; read-only READ COMMITTED allowed; selected authority installation, source epoch and release; no live endpoint requirement; no raw-table privilege. profiles.name: weft_execution
profiles.definition: Native Weft runtime query capability/0.8: actual accepted original documents and native mappings; explicit Weft-owned exact numeric preparation preserving original source/pins; bounded complete rootless and owned exact scalar string/boolean/mathematical integer/decimal/timestamp/binary sources; equality filters/joins, counts, ordering/limits and alias expansion; original decimal tokens for all projections and exact Python int/Decimal results; validated finite stock-PostgreSQL numeric representability before predicates and parameters, with typed native-domain refusal rather than rounding; caller read-only or read-write READ COMMITTED transaction; complete document/module authority and current context checks; independent or owned directed monomorphic HAS_RELATED/RELATED_KEYS forward and inverse with authored required supported exact scalar keys; exact bounded key tuples/truncation; entity-page and related-entity-page with ordered authored required supported exact scalar keys, complete bounded source uniqueness and caller-managed live continuation; ungrouped count-summary; no composed-record properties, grouped summary, float carriers or internal retry. Native64 adds bounded acyclic nested array/map properties and retained cells, complete original descendant definition/read dependencies and exact scalar leaves; prior profile definitions remain retained. Record-valued property cells and descendant item evolution remain unsupported. This capability requires matching Weft backend0.4.41 and binding0.5 with truss-postgresql-logical-query/1.1 SHA2569b67333abf263078e7e7239fe5accc228b063dc2fcc5488ca068d7331986949f; actual installation/runtime bytes remain bound and checked natively. This ordinary query profile does not activate protected current-policy or aggregate query cohorts. The matching published Weft0.4.40 additionally admits decimal(12,2) and uses stable UMF record/field IDs when authored names are absent, refusing ambiguous SQL names. Ordinary canonical Gregorian date projection and C-collated equality support literal, field and exact TextValue parameters with absent/null preserved; compile/IR/backend0.2.7. profiles.policyDefinition: Native Weft runtime query policy/0.2: ordinary original authenticated session person; complete current reader/writer authority for every selected original document module and declaration owner; independently safe fixed source functions with exact native mappings; final same-person/catalog/release check; no raw table privilege. retainedProfiles.definition: Native Weft runtime query capability/0.6: actual accepted original documents and native mappings; explicit Weft-owned exact numeric preparation preserving original source/pins; bounded complete rootless and owned exact scalar string/boolean/mathematical integer/decimal/timestamp/binary sources; equality filters/joins, counts, ordering/limits and alias expansion; original decimal tokens for all projections and exact Python int/Decimal results; validated finite stock-PostgreSQL numeric representability before predicates and parameters, with typed native-domain refusal rather than rounding; caller read-only or read-write READ COMMITTED transaction; complete document/module authority and current context checks; independent or owned directed monomorphic HAS_RELATED/RELATED_KEYS forward and inverse with authored required supported exact scalar keys; exact bounded key tuples/truncation; entity-page and related-entity-page with ordered authored required supported exact scalar keys, complete bounded source uniqueness and caller-managed live continuation; ungrouped count-summary; no composed-record properties, grouped summary, float carriers or internal retry. Native64 adds bounded acyclic nested array/map properties and retained cells, complete original descendant definition/read dependencies and exact scalar leaves; prior profile definitions remain retained. Record-valued property cells and descendant item evolution remain unsupported. Native69 requires matching Weft backend0.4.38 and binding0.5 with truss-postgresql-logical-query/1.0 SHA2569fce2c91eff11ae2d8e6c0e3759b425efb1457e2c9675dc4383fc28430909806; actual installation/runtime bytes remain bound and checked natively. Current and retained original root-owner modules must be selected and readable; descendant metadata attribution follows original transition evidence. This ordinary query profile does not activate protected current-policy or aggregate query cohorts.
retainedProfiles.policyDefinition: Native Weft runtime query policy/0.2: ordinary original authenticated session person; complete current reader/writer authority for every selected original document module and declaration owner; independently safe fixed source functions with exact native mappings; final same-person/catalog/release check; no raw table privilege. Owned queries additionally require current aggregate-root owners and original retained transition root owners within the exact selected document/module closure; no live-root fallback for historical attribution.
